description: Pass one message to the apply AI on the user's computer, exactly as if the user typed it in the app's chat, e.g. "apply to everything on my list" or "pick 10 backend new-grad roles that match my resume". By default it goes to the persistent Skills conversation (opened on first use); pass taskId to send it to a specific conversation. If that conversation is running, the message does not interrupt it: it is handed over with the next step or queued until the turn ends. When the apply AI applies because of it, each application uses 1 Auto Apply credit once it is filled up to the submit step or submitted (once per application; nothing while unlimited is active). Replies with where the app put it (started / handed over with the next step / queued) and the conversation id; then use get_job_apply_client_status for progress and the AI's replies. Requires the AceRound Auto Apply desktop app on the user’s computer to be signed in and open (running in the background after closing the window also works); if the app is offline or outdated, the tool says so. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)

text.description: The message for the apply AI, written in the user's voice

name: send_job_apply_instruction
